kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-table --table-name tableName1 --columns ColumnName=columnName1 Comment=备注 ColumnType=string Length=10 IsPartitionCol=true ColumnNameCn=中文名 SeqNumber=1 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a view or table. Valid values:

0: Create a table.

1: Create a view
parameters.help_zh:
指定创建视图或创建表：
0为创建表。
1为创建视图
parameters.name: is_view

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the table or workspace is visible. Valid values:

0: Both the table and workspace are invisible.

1: Both the table and workspace are visible.

2: Only the workspace is visible
parameters.help_zh:
表或工作空间是否可见：
0为表和工作空间均不可见。
1为表和工作空间均可见。
2为仅工作空间可见
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The lifecycle of the table. Unit: days. By default, this parameter is left empty, which indicates that the table is permanently stored
parameters.help_zh: 表的生命周期，单位为天。默认取值为空，表示永久存储
parameters.name: life_cycle

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated category. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173932.html operation to query the IDs of all categories that can be associated
parameters.help_zh: 关联类目的ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173932.html接口查询可以关联的类目ID
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical level
parameters.name: logical_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the physical level
parameters.name: physics_level_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the external table. Valid values:

0: Object Storage Service (OSS)

1: Tablestore

2: Volume

3: MySQL
parameters.help_zh:
外部表的存储类型。取值如下：
0表示OSS。
1表示TableStore。
2表示Volume。
3表示MySQL
parameters.name: external_table_type

parameters.help_en: The storage location of the external table
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en:
The environment type of the DataWorks workspace. Valid values:

0: development environment

1: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的环境。取值如下：
0表示开发环境。
1表示生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MaxCompute project. Specify the ID in the odps.{projectName} format
parameters.name: app_guid

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create a MaxCompute partitioned table. Valid values: 1 and 0. The value 1 indicates a partitioned table. The value 0 indicates a non-partitioned table. This parameter is deprecated. Do not use this parameter. The Column.N.isPartitionCol parameter is used to specify whether to create a MaxCompute partitioned table. If the Column.N.isPartitionCol parameter is set to true, a MaxCompute partitioned table is created
parameters.help_zh:
创建的MaxCompute表是否为分区表，包括1（是）和0（否）。该字段已废弃，请勿使用。
目前代码会根据Column.N.isPartitionCol参数判断MaxCompute表是否为分区表，当Column.N.isPartitionCol参数取值为true时，则认为MaxCompute表为分区表
parameters.name: has_part

parameters.help_en: The schema information of the table. You need to enter the schema information of the table if you enable the table schema in MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh: 表Schema信息。在ODPS，当您启动了三层模型时需要填写Schema信息
parameters.name: schema

fields.help_en: The name of the field. You can configure a maximum of 1,000 fields when you call the CreateTable operation to create a table
fields.help_zh:
字段的名称。
CreateTable API当前最多支持配置1000个字段
fields.name: column_name

fields.help_en: The display name of the field
fields.name: column_name_cn

fields.help_en: The data type of the field. For information about supported data types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27821.html in MaxCompute documentation
fields.help_zh: 字段的类型。此处支持的字段类型，取决于您MaxCompute项目使用的数据类型版本，各版本支持的数据类型请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27821.html
fields.name: column_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the field is a partition field
fields.help_zh: 当前字段是否为分区字段
fields.name: is_partition_col

fields.help_en: The length of the field. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159541.html
fields.name: length

fields.help_en: The sequence number of the field. You can use this parameter to specify how fields are sorted in a table. By default, fields are sorted based on the order in which requests are created. If the field is a partition field, this parameter is not supported
fields.help_zh:
字段的序列号。您可以指定字段在表中的排序，默认按照创建请求的顺序排序。
如果字段为分区字段，则不支持配置Columns.N.SeqNumber
fields.name: seq_number

parameters.help_en: The list of fields. A maximum of 1,000 fields are supported
parameters.help_zh: 字段列表，最大支持1000个字段
parameters.name: columns

fields.help_en: The level that corresponds to the theme ID
fields.name: theme_level

TaskInfo.description_en:
The information about the request task. After a request task is submitted, it is divided into multiple subtasks that are run in sequence. After the current subtask is complete, the next subtask starts to run. After all subtasks are complete, the request task is complete.

If a request task is aborted due to one of the following issues, address the issue based on the error code and initiate the request task again:

The request task fails to be submitted.

After the request task is submitted, a subtask fails to run
TaskInfo.description_zh:
请求任务的信息。
请求任务提交成功后，会被分为多个子任务有序执行。当前子任务执行成功后，才会继续执行下一个子任务，所有子任务执行完毕，该请求任务结束。

如下情况，请求任务会终止，您需要根据错误码信息解决问题后重新发起请求任务：
请求任务提交失败。
请求任务提交成功后，任意子任务执行失败

Content.description_en:
The details about the status of the current subtask.

If the current subtask is successful, success is returned.

If the current subtask fails, the error details are displayed
Content.description_zh:
当前子任务的执行状态详细信息。具体如下：
执行成功，则显示success。
执行失败则显示对应的报错详情

NextTaskId.description_en: The ID of the subtask that you want to run. If this parameter is left empty, all subtasks are complete
NextTaskId.description_zh: 即将执行的子任务ID。如果该字段为空，则表示所有子任务均已结束

Status.description_en:
The status of the current subtask. Valid values:

operating: The subtask is running.

success: The subtask succeeds.

failure: The subtask fails to run. For more information about the error details, see the Content parameter
Status.description_zh:
当前执行的子任务的状态信息。取值如下：
operating表示子任务正在执行中。
success表示子任务执行成功。
failure表示子任务执行失败。详细的报错信息请参见Content参数

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the current subtask
